_meta.researchedFrom: Official sources only: canada.ca (IRCC) and gov.uk (UKVI)

visitor_visa.name: Visitor Visa (Temporary Resident Visa)
eligibilityCriteria: Hold a valid travel document (passport)
Be in good health; a medical exam may be required
Have no criminal or immigration-related convictions
Demonstrate ties to your home country (job, home, financial assets, family)
Convince an immigration officer you will leave Canada at the end of your visit
Have enough money to support your stay
requiredDocuments: Proof of financial support (bank statements, pay stubs)
Letter of invitation from a Canadian host, if applicable
Biometrics (fingerprints and photo) at a Visa Application Centre
visitor_visa.processingTime: Varies by country of application. IRCC publishes current estimates by country on its processing-times tool; recent published figures include roughly 22 days for applicants from the United States and 27 days for applicants from India (as of April 2026).
visitor_visa.fees: CAD $100 visa fee + CAD $85 biometrics fee (approx. CAD $185 total per adult); capped at CAD $500 for a family of 5 or more applying together
visitor_visa.validityDuration: Up to 10 years or until passport expiry, whichever comes first; usually multiple-entry

study_permit.name: Study Permit
eligibilityCriteria: Have an acceptance letter from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
Prove sufficient funds for tuition, living costs, and return transportation
Have no criminal record; a police certificate may be required
Be in good health; a medical exam may be required
Satisfy an officer that you will leave Canada when your permit expires
A Provincial or Territorial Attestation Letter (PAL/TAL) is required for most applicants under the study-permit cap; certain doctoral and master's research programs are exempt as of January 2026
requiredDocuments: Letter of acceptance from a DLI
study_permit.processingTime: Varies by country of application; check IRCC's processing-times tool for the current estimate
study_permit.fees: CAD $150 study permit fee + CAD $85 biometrics fee, where required
study_permit.validityDuration: Length of the study program plus 90 days

work_permit.name: Work Permit
eligibilityCriteria: Have a valid job offer supported by a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) or an LMIA exemption for employer-specific permits, or qualify under an open work permit category
Prove you meet the requirements of the job
Have enough money for your stay
Have no serious criminal or medical inadmissibility
Convince an officer you will leave Canada when your permit expires
requiredDocuments: Job offer / LMIA number or LMIA-exemption code (employer-specific permits)
Proof of qualifications for the job
work_permit.processingTime: Varies by permit type and country of application; typically several weeks up to a few months
work_permit.fees: CAD $155 work permit fee; + CAD $100 open work permit holder fee for open permits; + CAD $85 biometrics fee. Employers may also pay a $1,000 LMIA fee or $230 compliance fee.
work_permit.validityDuration: Tied to the job offer/LMIA duration or program conditions; renewable

standard_visitor_visa.name: Standard Visitor Visa
eligibilityCriteria: Hold a valid passport or travel document for the whole stay
Show you will leave the UK at the end of your visit
Show you can support yourself and any dependants during the trip
Show you can pay for your return or onward journey
Show you will not live in the UK for extended periods through frequent or successive visits
requiredDocuments: Evidence of funds to support the visit
Evidence of ties to home country / return travel plans
Biometric information (fingerprints and photo) at a UKVCAS appointment
standard_visitor_visa.processingTime: Standard service aims for a decision within 3 weeks; priority and super-priority services are available for an extra fee
standard_visitor_visa.fees: £135 for up to 6 months; long-term options available (2, 5, or 10 years) for frequent visitors
standard_visitor_visa.validityDuration: Up to 6 months per visit; long-term visas allow repeat visits within a 2/5/10-year window

skilled_worker_visa.name: Skilled Worker Visa
eligibilityCriteria: Have a confirmed job offer from a Home Office-licensed sponsor
Hold a Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) for an eligible occupation
Be paid at least the minimum salary for the role, based on job type and CoS date (see gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa/your-job for current thresholds)
Meet the required knowledge of English (CEFR B2, as of 8 January 2026)
requiredDocuments: Proof of personal savings, where required
skilled_worker_visa.processingTime: 3 weeks if applying from outside the UK; 8 weeks if applying from inside the UK
skilled_worker_visa.fees: Application fee varies by route and visa length, plus the Immigration Health Surcharge per year of stay; see gov.uk/skilled-worker-visa/how-much-it-costs for current rates
skilled_worker_visa.validityDuration: Up to 5 years per grant; extendable, and can lead to settlement after 5 years

student_visa.name: Student Visa
eligibilityCriteria: Be 16 or over
Have an unconditional offer and Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from a licensed student sponsor
Show you have enough money to support yourself and pay for your course
Meet the required knowledge of English
Have parental consent if you are 16 or 17
requiredDocuments: Proof of funds (tuition and living costs, held for 28 consecutive days)
TB test certificate, if applicable to your country
ATAS certificate, for certain postgraduate courses
student_visa.processingTime: 3 weeks if applying from outside the UK; 8 weeks if applying from inside the UK
student_visa.fees: £558 to apply from outside the UK (same fee to extend or switch from inside the UK), plus the Immigration Health Surcharge
student_visa.validityDuration: Up to 5 years for degree-level courses if you're 18 or over; up to 2 years for below-degree-level courses

_notes.digitalNomad: Neither Canada nor the UK offers a dedicated digital nomad visa as of September 2026. Canada permits visitors to work remotely for a foreign employer/clients for up to 6 months under existing visitor rules (IRCC guidance updated 26 May 2026); the UK has no equivalent provision and remote workers typically rely on the Standard Visitor visa's general permitted activities. No separate record was seeded for this category per country to avoid duplicating the visitor-visa entry with fabricated distinctions.
